'File Name: mainnet/contracts/market/v0-4-market.clar -> Scope: High. `status-multi` MISALIGNS ONE USER'S ASSETS WITH ANOTHER'S FLAGS. `(map unwrap-status ids mask)` is a two-list map where `mask` is `uint-to-list-u64` of the enabled bitmap, so an asset id is paired positionally with one element of that expansion rather than with the whole bitmap, and `map` truncates to the shorter list. Since `ids` comes from the position being evaluated, two different users produce two different pairings. Show a victim whose collateral or debt flags come out wrong purely because of which assets it holds. Impact: direct theft, or protocol insolvency.'
